layout.footer.account: You received this email because of an action on your {shop} account. If it was not you, contact the shop.
layout.footer.order: You received this email because of your order at {shop}.
admin.test.subject: Test email from {shop}
admin.test.heading: Test email
admin.test.body: Email delivery works: this message was handed to the provider {provider}.
admin.test.note: You asked for this test in the admin. No action is needed.
customer.password_reset.subject: Reset your password at {shop}
customer.password_reset.heading: Reset your password
customer.password_reset.body: We received a request to reset the password of your account at {shop}. Use the button below to choose a new one. The link works once and for {minutes} minutes.
customer.password_reset.link_hint: If the button does not work, open this link:
customer.password_reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
customer.password_changed.subject: Your password at {shop} was changed
customer.password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
customer.password_changed.body: The password of your account at {shop} was just changed with a reset link. Every device that was signed in has been signed out.
customer.password_changed.warning: If it was not you, contact {shop} at once.
customer.verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address at {shop}
customer.verify_email.heading: Confirm your email address
customer.verify_email.body: Confirm that this address belongs to your account at {shop}. The link works for {hours} hours.
customer.verify_email.link_hint: If the button does not work, open this link:
customer.verify_email.ignore: If you did not create an account at {shop}, ignore this email.
order.placed.subject: Order {number} accepted at {shop}
order.placed.heading: Thank you for your order
order.placed.more_lines: More lines in your order: {count}. Open your order to see all of them.
order.placed.payment_notice: The order is waiting for payment. Pay before {deadline}, otherwise the order expires and the reserved items are released.
order.placed.link_hint: If the button does not work, open this link:
order.placed.note: You received this email because you placed an order at {shop}.
order.paid.subject: Payment for order {number} received
order.paid.heading: Payment received
order.paid.body: {shop} received the payment of {total} for order {number}.
order.paid.next: We are preparing your order now.
order.paid.link_hint: If the button does not work, open this link:
order.cancelled.subject: Order {number} cancelled
order.cancelled.heading: Your order was cancelled
order.cancelled.body: Order {number} at {shop} was cancelled and its reserved items were released.
order.cancelled.note: If you have questions about this order, contact {shop}.
order.expired.subject: Order {number} expired
order.expired.heading: Your order expired
order.expired.body: {shop} did not receive the payment for order {number} in time, so the order expired and its reserved items were released.
order.expired.note: You can place a new order at {shop} at any time.
